pattern: HTTP requests run through the selected execution computer
experience: The development request lab supports agent and client workflows through one bounded service.
prompt: Use Loom's development request lab to GET http://localhost:3000/health on this execution computer. Send it exactly once and report the returned status and body. Do not open a browser, run curl, start a dev server or change any files.

pattern: history inspection does not replay or clear requests
experience: Saved request history can be inspected separately from side-effecting sends and clearing.
prompt: Read the saved HTTP response for exchangeId health-request using Loom's development tools and summarize it. This is read-only: do not send or replay a request, clear history, or alter the target server.
